verdict.rationale: Unleash documents its own API keys for 'other tools and automation'. Backend tokens are scoped to one or more projects and a single environment, and RBAC supports custom root and project roles. However, the scoped token type shown is for SDK/Edge reads, and the evidence never ties least-privilege scoping to admin-capable credentials an agent would use to manage flags. missing for 10: documented scoped admin/service-account tokens bound to custom roles, agent-specific credential guidance (e.g. for the MCP server), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Backend tokens are scoped to one or more projects and a single environment.
Unleash uses API keys to facilitate communication between consuming clients such as SDKs, Unleash Edge, or other tools and automation.
Enterprise users can create their own custom root roles and custom project roles.
